name: ubiquiti-unifi-cef-audit
description: Parses UniFi Network audit events shipped as CEF over syslog. The regex captures only the CEF envelope (linear, ReDoS-safe); the engine's CEF extension parser explodes the key=value pairs (handling unquoted spaces in values), and derivations map them to canonical fields. The syslog time/host prefix is optional so the header-stripped message SIEMBox stores also matches. Requires the extension to start with UNIFIcategory=Audit (the discriminator vs. the IDS/IPS parser).

test_samples.input: Jun 24 14:45:44 UCG-Max CEF:0|Ubiquiti|UniFi Network|10.4.57|544|Network Accessed|4|UNIFIcategory=Audit UNIFIhost=UCG Max UNIFIaccessMethod=web UNIFIadmin=cladkins src=192.168.1.130 UNIFIutcTime=2026-06-24T19:45:44.918Z msg=cladkins accessed UniFi Network using the web. Source IP: 192.168.1.130

expect.message: cladkins accessed UniFi Network using the web. Source IP: 192.168.1.130

test_samples.description: Header-stripped CEF line (after ingest tag guard) still matches
test_samples.input: CEF:0|Ubiquiti|UniFi Network|10.4.57|544|Network Accessed|4|UNIFIcategory=Audit UNIFIhost=UCG Max UNIFIaccessMethod=web UNIFIadmin=cladkins src=192.168.1.130 UNIFIutcTime=2026-06-24T19:45:44.918Z msg=cladkins accessed UniFi Network using the web. Source IP: 192.168.1.130

expect.message: cladkins accessed UniFi Network using the web. Source IP: 192.168.1.130
